name: stress-ng mcontend
description: Start N workers that produce memory contention read/write patterns. Each stressor runs with 5 threads that read and write to two different mappings of the same underlying physical page. Various caching operations are also exercised to cause sub-optimal memory access patterns. The threads also randomly change CPU affinity to exercise CPU and memory migration stress. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.duration: Duration (seconds) of the benchmarking framework run that produced this score, shared by all benchmarks and configs of that run.
